data.name: Mujju
data.gender_notes: Mujju is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘मुज्ज’, meaning ‘to touch’, this name symbolizes the touch of blessings and fortune in one's life. The name Mujju carries the meaning “Blessed, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mujju usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that brings the blessings of the divine.
data.etymology: Mujju belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, Fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujju total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
